name: Mousou Taiiku Kyoushi ~Bloomers no Suji wa Tooshite Moraimasu~
original_name: 妄想体育教師～ブルマの筋は通してもらいます～
source:
The main character becomes a PE teacher just to see a girl wearing bloomers. If things go well, he wants to touch it. However, the reality is hard.... He can't take in charge of a girl's class. But one day, a female teacher who is in charge of a girl's class gets injured and hospitalized! His wish now comes true! At first, he chooses a target girl, Orie. He gives her a private lesson after school and touches her body. However, she still believes he does it for her. Well, his lesson gradually gets bolder and bolder...

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090304202803/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1009996]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
主角为了看穿运动短裤的女孩而成为体育老师。如果进展顺利，他还想摸一摸。然而现实很残酷……他无法负责女生班。但有一天，负责女生班的女老师受伤住院了！他的愿望终于实现了！首先，他选定了目标女孩织绘。放学后他给她上私人课程，触碰她的身体。然而，她仍然相信他是为了她好。就这样，他的课程逐渐变得越来越大胆……
